scripts.build: react-scripts build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); const src=path.join(process.cwd(),'build'); const dest=path.join(process.cwd(),'..','build'); if (fs.existsSync(dest)) fs.rmSync(dest,{recursive:true,force:true}); fs.cpSync(src,dest,{recursive:true});"
